notes:
User is building consistent weekend and bedtime routines. Plans Saturday jog: wake around 7:30 a.m., drink coffee, start around 8:15–8:30, and jog 30 minutes. Prefers a relatively flat route with shade near their downtown area and will use route-finding tools to find one, checking water fountains/stations along the way. Will leave earbuds behind to stay aware of surroundings. After jogging, prefers a 5–10-minute gradual slowdown followed by gentle stretching/light mobility, hydration, and refueling; wants a cool-down routine to reduce soreness.

Sunday plan: wake around the same time, do 30 minutes of gentle yoga/stretching after a desk-heavy week, have quick breakfast, then meal prep. Prefers starting small and gradually increasing duration/intensity.

Interested in entrepreneurship/startups. Chose Eric Ries’s *The Lean Startup* as a starting book, especially Build-Measure-Learn, MVPs, customer feedback, experimentation, and iteration, and plans to apply these principles to personal projects.

Reading goal: 30 minutes nightly before bed, beginning with *The Lean Startup*. Wants focus and retention while tired through a distraction-free setting, 25/5 Pomodoro, active notes/summarie
